lines: This was the escape route that Shizuru had prepared.
Using these sewers, we would be able to proceed to the entrance of Yomihara without having to pass through the dangerous streets of the city.
Oohh... It got a lot quieter back there. Looks like we gave those fat-asses the slip.
Yamata no Orochi, who had been walking in front, turned around and cracked a smile.
I also checked behind us, making sure that we were safe.
These sewers had many branches and were almost like a maze.
With this much of a lead, it was likely the Trolls wouldn't be able to catch us.
Yamata no Orochi, let's take a short break. I'm worried about everyone's fatigue.
A break? ...Alright, got it. I don't need breaks, but whatever the boss says goes.
The female warrior shrugged her shoulders and sat down by the wall holding her enormous sword.
In actuality, Hebiko, Shikanosuke, and I were not even that tired.
But I still took a break for Sago-san's sake.
Is your body holding up, Sago-san?
Y-Yes... I'm sorry for the trouble, Hebiko-kun.
Due to his cyborg body malfunctioning, Sago-san wasn't able to move properly at the moment.
And even with Hebiko supporting him, this forced march must have been quite hard on him.
Good gracious, how utterly pathetic I am... Needing a young lady like you to support me...
C'mon now, don't talk like that! Heberyone's mission is to rescue you, Sago-san!
Don't hesitate to rely a bit more on Hebiko♪
Hehe... You're young, but you're a good Taimanin. Thank you. I'll take you up on your offer.
Sago's strained voice softened a little.
Hebiko's cheerfulness and bravery seemed to have warmed his heart.
(But from the looks of it... Hebiko and Sago-san can't be counted on in battle.)
Hebiko was supporting Sago-san and would not be able to participate in combat. And the same could be said about the person with the malfunctioning cyborg body himself.
(Which means that our group's firepower is three people...)
We had shaken off the Trolls chasing us, but there was something else to worry about in these sewers.
According to Shizuru, these sewers were also affected by the Gate to the Devildom.
In other words, they had become home to dangerous demonic creatures...
(Well then, how will three of us be able to cut our way through this...?)
I was racking my brain trying to find a strategy in case we should need it.
From right beside me, I heard a voice that was free of any nervousness.
H-Hey, look at this, Fuma!! My snacks have disappeared!!!
Your snacks...? You were going to eat snacks right now?
Now's the perfect time!! I'm just trying to relieve some of my fatigue during our break.
Being able to regain strength during a break was a crucial point that could determine the success or failure of a mission.
So we each had brought our own portable rations of preserved food and snacks.
But forget about that! My snacks are more important here! The soy sauce cookies I bought at Inageya!!
I didn't eat them and saved them until now, but they're not in my bag!!!
Pfft, by snacks you meant soy sauce cookies? Aren't those a bit strong-tasting?
...I mean, they can't hold a candle to Saika-san's cookies that I tried before, but...
Well, that's because Saika's homemade cookies are the best.
Come to think of it, Saika's cookies I had brought with me had also disappeared from my bag...
But still! They're not here! You ate them, didn't you? Last night, sneakily, when you got hungry!
Huh!? No way I'd eat them!! I mean, my snacks were also eaten! That was you, wasn't it!?
Your snacks!? I didn't eat them!!
Hm-hm... You're so full of energy, boys. If you've got that kind of energy, you don't need a break, do you?
Just as we were getting invested in our trivial argument, Yamata no Orochi called out to us.
Ah, no... it's nothing. Please don't mind us...
(See!? Because you're so noisy, she looked at us as if we're stupid!)
Lowering our voices, we kept at it.
(On our way to Yomihara, Sana-san's can had also been empty...)
I had been slightly concerned about it at the time, but had forgotten about it because of the difficulties we had faced on the journey.
What the hell, Fuma!? So you're the one who ate them after all!? You just remembered something, didn't you!?
Wait, Shikanosuke, did you hear something just now...?
Eeeeh!? What do you mean by "something!?" Even if you start telling ghost stories in a place like this, I won't fall for it―
...That's not it. You can't hear anything? There's the sound of something far away coming closer...
The sound of something like a massive body slithering got closer to us little by little.
I-I-I can hear iiiiit!!!! What is it!? One of your pranks!? That's what it is, isn't iiiiit!!?
Dummy, who's gonna play such a boring prank!! Shizuru said before, didn't she!? The reason why nobody ever enters the sewers is―
...Because they're a nest for demonic creatures. That's why they'd be convenient as an escape route...
Hideous monsters appeared from the darkness deep within the sewers.
Oh, looks like our break is over. Show us a good time, you monsters!!
